expectations.evidence: Only HEMMELIG and KONFIDENSIELT are mentioned. The full five levels (UGRADERT, BEGRENSET, KONFIDENSIELT, HEMMELIG, STRENGT HEMMELIG) are not listed.
Section 2.1 covers Sikkerhetsloven in detail, referencing Chapter 5 (Informasjonssikkerhet), Chapter 6 (Personellsikkerhet), Chapter 7 (Fysisk sikring), and Chapter 9 (Anskaffelsessikkerhet).
NSM is identified as the accreditation authority (Section 2.2) and referenced throughout for approvals, guidance, and liaison (Sections 6, 7, 9, 11).

NSM Grunnprinsipper is never mentioned. The document references RHEL STIG, CIS benchmarks, and FIPS/STIG-aligned distributions as hardening baselines, which are US-centric frameworks rather than the Norwegian NSM Grunnprinsipper.
Section 2.2 states 'only NSM-approved crypto devices and algorithms are permitted.' Section 7.2 and 14 reinforce NSM-approved crypto requirements.
Section 3.1 explicitly models the 8 cleared personnel constraint with role allocation table. Section 10.3 details staffing model across all 8 FTEs.
Section 2.3 and Section 6 cover NATO interoperability including STANAG 4774/4778, FMN, NATO SECRET mapping, and NATO gateway architecture.
Section 6.2 details CDS/guard requirements including NSM-accredited products (Thales, Advenica, Everfox/Forcepoint), content inspection, classification label validation, and protocol break.

TEMPEST is mentioned only in passing: 'TEMPEST-rated devices' for bulk encryptors (line 195) and 'TEMPEST-rated if required' for switches (line 365). No dedicated TEMPEST requirements section or zoning discussion.
Section 5.1 header states 'Norwegian Sovereign Soil.' The architecture is fully air-gapped and physically located in Norway. Supply chain follows Sikkerhetsloven Chapter 9.
No mention of EU/EEA context, NIS2 directive, or GDPR anywhere in the document.

Multiple US-centric references: RHEL STIG, FIPS, CIS benchmarks as hardening baselines; US DoD Platform One/Iron Bank cited as rationale; STIG-aligned distribution recommended. These are used as primary frameworks instead of Norwegian equivalents like NSM Grunnprinsipper.
